description: Poised Kagami proportions with centered posture, readable uniform silhouette, and precise gaze transitions.

motionGrammar.idle: Poised breath and blink with controlled hair or garment follow-through.
motionGrammar.directionalRun: Precise alternating travel with an upright center and clear facing.
motionGrammar.wave: Small formal greeting led by hand and wrist.
motionGrammar.jump: Centered athletic hop with controlled landing.
motionGrammar.failed: Contained disappointment through face, head, and shoulders.
motionGrammar.waiting: Expectant lean or measured foot shift.
motionGrammar.working: Focused study-like hand and eye movement with no added object.
motionGrammar.review: Careful inspection followed by a decisive nod.
motionGrammar.look: Eyes and eyelids lead, then head, neck, hair, and upper body follow in an even clockwise loop.
